dedupe_keys.name: energy system models for finland 2023 and 2030 including power and district heating sectors energyplan and calliope

description: This data set contains ready-to-run models of the Finnish energy system, covering the power and district heating sectors, for the reference year 2023 and scenarios for 2030. It was published by Jaakko Hyypiä, Päivi Sikiö, Hossein Enayatizadeh and Tero Tynjälä. Models are given for two frameworks, EnergyPLAN version 16.3 and Calliope version 0.6, with the distribution (profile) files used in the simulations, Calliope results and Python notebooks for post-processing. District heating includes heat pumps, electric boilers, combined heat and power, boilers, heat recovery and waste incineration CHP, and the 2030 scenarios vary wind power capacity and replace boilers with 1,800 to 3,600 MW of heat pumps or electric boilers, with one scenario optimising heat capacities in Calliope and a sensitivity analysis of heat pump COP and investment cost. Coverage is Finland at national level with hourly model profiles. Files are on Mendeley Data (version 2, April 2026) under CC-BY-4.0 at no cost. Caveats: scenarios reflect one study's questions, and the model versions used are specific. Simulation uses are power and district heating capacity planning and dispatch optimisation for Finland, and a starting point for new Finnish scenarios. Related records: none linked on the provider's pages read on the day.
